## Set Up 

```{r}
# Libraries 
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

```{r}
# Data 

# ----- Hawkwatch data sets ----
# Total dataset
hw_full_raw <- read_csv(here("data", "hawk-watch", "Hawkwatch_Final.csv"))

# 2025 dataset 
hw_2025_raw <- read_csv(here("data", "hawk-watch", "Hawkwatch_2025_0.csv"))

```


## Exploration
